name: Decline Push-Up
equipment: A box or bench (optional feet-elevated variation)
instructions: Lie face down and place your hands about shoulder-width apart, holding your torso up at arm's length. Move your feet up onto a box or bench. This is the starting position.
Lower yourself downward until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.
Press your upper body back up to the starting position while squeezing your chest, exhaling as you go.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
